recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片中一小群大小相近的芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少至中等嗜鹼性，但細胞質一側可見聚集的粗大紫紅色嗜天青顆粒，外觀近似前骨髓細胞或嗜鹼性球；結合 B-ALL 病史與 MPO 陰性，為顆粒型（hypergranular）B-ALL 的中樞神經復發。
features: Cluster of medium to large blasts with round nuclei and high N:C ratio
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not well seen
Coarse purple-pink azurophilic granules aggregated in one region of the cytoplasm, partly overlying the nucleus
No Auer rods; clean CSF background without other inflammatory cells
describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a small cluster of medium to large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and basophilic cytoplasm. Many blasts contain coarse azurophilic granules aggregated in a paranuclear region of the cytoplasm, mimicking promyelocytes or basophils. Auer rods are not seen. In a patient with known precursor B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (CD19+, CD10+, TdT+, MPO negative), findings are consistent with CNS relapse of B-lymphoblastic leukemia with granular (hypergranular) blast morphology.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia / acute promyelocytic leukemia
ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts with azurophilic granules are MPO positive and may have Auer rods, whereas these granular lymphoblasts are MPO negative and express CD19, CD10 and TdT.
Basophilic blasts show metachromatic granules with toluidine blue and express CD123/CD203c without B-lineage markers.
Reactive cells are heterogeneous with mature chromatin and lack the uniform blastic nuclei with fine chromatin.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with lipid vacuoles rather than azurophilic granules and are TdT negative with MYC rearrangement.
